🎥🎬: BEHEMOTH! (2026)
Alex Serian has spent two decades pursuing his passion for music, travelling from city to city as a gifted cellist. But when he returns to Los Angeles, he discovers that time has changed the people and relationships he once knew.
Determined to reconnect with his family, Alex must confront the distance created by years of absence and reconsider the life he has built around his career. As music brings old memories back to life, he embarks on a journey that challenges everything he thought he understood about happiness and belonging.

source_details.synopsis: Behemoth! is a 2026 American drama film written and directed by Tony Gilroy. It stars Pedro Pascal, Olivia Wilde, Eva Victor, and Will Arnett. The film premiered at the 64th New York Film Festival on October 2, 2026, and received positive reviews from critics for Pascal's performance, Gilroy's direction, and the musical score but received criticism for its writing and structure. It is scheduled to be released in the United States by Searchlight Pictures on December 4, 2026.
